name: DF40 Frozen-Expert Feature Cache
description: Frozen-expert feature cache derived from the DF40 deepfake benchmark (Yan et al., NeurIPS 2024): penultimate features and binary logits of 21 frozen DF40 detectors for the FIT and SELECT training splits and 8 held-out test generators. No raw DF40 media or detector weights are included. Our derived-cache contributions use CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; upstream terms remain applicable. Details: README.md. The arrays are read with NumPy and the paired code; mlcroissant 1.1.0 validates the metadata but does not provide an application/x-numpy record decoder. The metadata includes an embedded list of 17 source-integrity exclusions. The cache remains unfiltered; the exclusions are optional annotations and are not applied automatically. The distribution contains 460 data/provenance files at the reviewed revision; the current release notice is verified separately through CACHE_PROVENANCE.json.
citeAs: Pereira, A., Ransom, K. J., & Mitchell, L. (2026). When Are Predictions Enough? An Evaluation Protocol for Frozen Expert Composition. NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Derived from DF40 (Yan et al., NeurIPS 2024), using its DeepfakeBench-based code. Also cite Yan, Z., Zhang, Y., Yuan, X., Lyu, S., & Wu, B. (2023). DeepfakeBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Deepfake Detection. Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, 36, 4534-4565. See LICENSE_NOTICE.txt for upstream attribution requirements.
rai:dataCollection: Derived: features and logits computed by running 21 frozen DF40 detectors over DF40 training partitions and 8 held-out test generators. No new raw data was collected.
rai:dataUseCases: Intended: auditing and reproducing frozen-expert composition methods on DF40 with the paired code release. Validity: the arrays are the frozen DF40 detectors' outputs on DF40 images, as extracted for the paper (checksums in distribution); the paired code documents how to rerun the DF40 combiner evaluations using these arrays. The cache is therefore valid for comparing combiners of these frozen experts on DF40; it is not established as a measure of deepfake detection on other data, demographic groups or deployment settings. Not intended: deployment, commercial products, or uses outside CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 and applicable upstream terms. Standard-split results are overlap-affected; leave-one-generator-out controls identified combiner train/test reuse but retains the limitations below. Details: the accompanying dataset card, "Intended use" and "Non-intended use".
rai:dataLimitations: One benchmark (DF40) and binary labels only; some DF40 detector variants and the e4e subset are excluded; no demographic, fairness or calibration metadata. The training pool is deduplicated by sample identifier, not necessarily by content. Most held-out test images also occur in FIT or SELECT, so standard-split results are overlap-affected; some source images were empty or repeated. Seventeen cache rows refer to nine distinct zero-byte source-file paths (FIT 7, SELECT 1, MidJourney 5, starganv2 4). Nine of these rows have cached labels that disagree with source-path classes (FIT 2, MidJourney 5, starganv2 2); all 17 are affected by the extraction loader fallback, including eight whose classes happen to agree. The complete exclusion list is embedded in recordSet records/source_integrity_exclusions and shown at the end of README.md under Source-integrity exclusions. These annotations do not filter the cache, relabel arrays, or change the paper results. Primary LOGO excludes identified training rows whose features match a held-out test image. Identical-feature checks cannot rule out re-encoded copies. LOGO retraining cannot undo exposure during frozen-expert training. Repeated content remains within training data, between FIT and SELECT, across inner cross-validation folds, and within test sets. Training deduplication sensitivity checks also change image weighting. Details and counts: the accompanying dataset card, "Train/test overlap", "Residual limitations under LOGO" and "Known integrity properties" (README.md on the Hub; DATASET_CARD.md in the cache directory).
rai:dataBiases: Inherits DF40's sampling: the held-out generators were chosen by the DF40 authors, class balance varies by split and does not reflect deployment prevalence, and demographic imbalance is not corrected (DF40 publishes facial-attribute annotations; this cache has none). Counts: README.md, "Splits".
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No raw images or explicit demographic annotations are included. The cache contains numerical feature and logit arrays, binary labels, and sample ids that are relative DF40 paths. The embeddings and source identifiers should not be assumed anonymous; absence of raw images does not establish absence of identity information. Some ids keep upstream file names with YouTube video identifiers or MidJourney prompt text (README.md, "Non-intended use"). DF40 itself contains face images. Re-identification of individuals falls outside the intended use of this cache. Respect applicable upstream terms and privacy rights.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Positive: reproducible audits of deepfake-detection composition without re-extracting features from DF40 images. Risk: the arrays could be used to study or evade specific detectors. Mitigations: non-commercial license, no detector weights, only forward-pass outputs.

prov:wasDerivedFrom.name: DF40
prov:wasDerivedFrom.citeAs: Yan, Z., Yao, T., Chen, S., Zhao, Y., Fu, X., Zhu, J., Luo, D., Wang, C., Ding, S., Wu, Y., Yuan, L. DF40: Toward Next-Generation Deepfake Detection. NeurIPS 2024 Datasets and Benchmarks Track.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.description: The DF40 loader uses c23 inputs at 256 x 256 with no augmentation and per-channel mean and standard deviation of 0.5. CLIP inputs are bilinearly resized to 224 x 224 with align_corners=False. Spatial feature maps are globally averaged. Each frozen DF40 detector is run in eval() mode under torch.no_grad() over DF40 inputs (FIT/SELECT splits derived from the DF40 training pool after deduplication by sample identifier, not necessarily by content, plus the 8 held-out OOD test generators). Per-image penultimate features and binary classifier logits are saved per expert as `.npy` arrays; sample_ids and labels are saved per split. No detector fine-tuning is performed. Stratified FIT/SELECT split uses random seed 1024. SHA-256 fingerprints are computed for every data/provenance file and listed in the dataset's `distribution` block. Generated by the extraction pipeline released with this cache in the code repository (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) (see `scripts/01_extract.py` and `scripts/02_resplit_fit_select.py`). Those scripts write Unicode identifier arrays; the published sample_ids.npy files are object arrays from a later sanitization that keeps the path after the last '/DF40/' with forward slashes, recorded in each split's provenance.json as sample_ids_sanitized_at (2026-04-29) and sample_ids_normalization. The code repository has no script for that step. Logit column 0 is real and column 1 is fake. Binary labels follow the same DF40/DeepfakeBench order and are saved as int32; see rai:dataLimitations and the dataset card for the known loader-fallback discrepancies. The source-integrity exclusion annotations were created by checking file sizes for all 51,163 cached row paths in the local extraction-source image copy on 2026-11-03T19:40:18.796441+00:00. No referenced source file was missing. Row indices and ids were checked against the checksum-verified cache. Seventeen affected cache rows map to nine distinct zero-byte source paths; the metadata annotations are not applied to the arrays.

recordSet.name: records/source_integrity_exclusions
recordSet.description: Complete optional exclusion annotations for all 17 cache rows with zero-byte source files: FIT 7, SELECT 1, MidJourney 5, starganv2 4. The 17 rows refer to nine distinct source paths. Nine label/path disagreements are a subset. Indices are zero-based and apply only to the original checksum-verified cache. For a filtered analysis, drop the rows consistently from features, logits, labels and ids before training, selection or testing. For LOGO, filter source-generator rows before fold construction and FIT/SELECT splitting. Metadata does not automatically apply these exclusions and the original paper results use the unchanged cache.

field.name: exclusion_id
field.description: Unique split:row_index identifier for this exclusion annotation.

field.name: split
field.description: Original cache folder name; FIT and SELECT are the original standard-split partitions, not rebuilt LOGO partitions.

field.name: row_index
field.description: Zero-based row index in every aligned array of the named cache split at pinned revision 18fb1b212f7251799fca8cb4d549be6d239ce13a.

field.name: sample_id
field.description: Exact relative source path stored in sample_ids.npy at row_index. Match both split and sample_id before excluding a row.

field.name: cached_label
field.description: Stored cache label (0 real, 1 fake), unchanged.

field.name: path_label
field.description: Class indicated by the real/fake component of the requested source path (0 real, 1 fake). This is not a corrected label for the substituted feature vector.

field.name: label_path_disagreement
field.description: True when cached_label differs from path_label; false does not make this row valid.

field.name: source_size_bytes
field.description: Source-file size observed in the local extraction-source image copy; zero for every listed row.

field.name: reason
field.description: zero_byte_source_loader_fallback: the requested source image was empty and the extraction loader substituted an item.
